SELECT tier, is_current, (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS open_ended, COUNT(*) AS versions, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, MIN(valid_from), MAX(valid_from), MAX(valid_to)
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT 'multi_current' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'no_current', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'valid_on_20261004_gold', COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND valid_from<=DATE '2026-10-04' AND valid_to>=DATE '2026-10-04'
UNION ALL SELECT 'current_gold', COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND is_current
UNION ALL SELECT 'tier_variants', COUNT(DISTINCT tier) FROM dim_member
UNION ALL SELECT 'overlap_versions', COUNT(*) FROM dim_member a JOIN dim_member b ON a.member_id=b.member_id AND a.member_key<b.member_key AND a.valid_from<=b.valid_to AND b.valid_from<=a.valid_to
